newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia cuts interest rates by 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Australia cuts interest rates by 0.5 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said on Wednesday that it would cut official interest rates by 0.5 percentage points to 6.0 percent.
Rates were last cut on November 6 when the official cash rate was brought down to 6.5 percent from 7.0 percent.
"This reduction essentially reflects a further improvement in the inflationary outlook," the RBA said in a statement.
The bank said it now expected inflation to stay below 2.5 percent for the remainder of 1996/97.
